calls.thesis: Re-evaluating his own holding (8.7% of community portfolio, avg ~EUR44, -23%). Down ~75% from 2024 ATH while adjusted operating profit is higher; PE ~10 vs 14-38 historically, div yield 4.6%, but moat at risk: semaglutide is 74% of revenue, Wegovy revenue -22% in Q2 2026 (price cuts, US govt deal, Lilly share gains), patent cliffs 2026 ex-US / 2032 US. Buy threshold tightened to ~180 DKK, currently 'right at the hold threshold', sell zone from 400 DKK. First NVO call on record.

calls.thesis: Uninspiring mid-single-digit growth outlook through 2030, but stock trades at cheapest valuation in years (11.3x fwd PE); ~68% upside over 12-18 months on his DCF.
calls.bull: Cost cuts fund R&D; AI lifts drug-development ROI; ROIC 37% (3-4x WACC) stabilizes.
calls.bear: ROIC has fallen from 80-90% over a decade; lowest R&D spend among peers (15.7%); patent loss pressures weight-loss franchise; he prefers LLY.
